components.name: Folded Signal Field
components.description: Canvas-rendered isometric material beneath real, interactive application HTML.

narrative.overview: Synod is an operating surface with depth, not a dashboard dressed in effects. A live isometric canvas field responds beneath translucent indigo planes while the companion remains the human anchor. The result feels dimensional and personal without moving the task away from the conversation.
keyCharacteristics: Canvas-powered isometric depth field behind live HTML
Indigo optical glass with mint guidance and violet synthesis
Prominent companion stage and one continuous conversation plane
Raised composer and disclosed council mechanics

rules.name: Field-Behind-Work
rules.body: Dimensional canvas effects always sit behind interactive HTML and may never obscure text, controls, or the presenter.

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Mint communicates action and healthy state; passive regions use neutral glass.

rules.name: Quiet Authority
rules.body: The advice should look certain because it is structured and readable, not because type is oversized or ultra-bold.

rules.name: Depth-With-Purpose
rules.body: 3D motion communicates spatial material and input response; it never becomes navigation, progress, or a replacement for state text.

dos: Do keep the companion and live conversation dominant over the council machinery.
Do use the canvas field as background depth only, with motion disabled or reduced when requested.
Do preserve a continuous conversation plane and structured decision sections.
Do reserve mint for commitment, healthy state, focus, and live input.
donts: Don't let a canvas, shader, or overlay cover interactive content.
Don't expose raw provider payloads or internal reasoning as primary UI.
Don't turn every result section into a floating rounded card.
Don't use decorative motion that delays or confuses a decision task.
